address: Impasse de la Linerie, Auzouville-sur-Saâne, 76730, France
bio: Alexandre and Mélanie Baranzelli are thriving in a new venue oozing with country charm: picture a stream spanned by two bridges and a watermill! The chef, after honing his skills in top establishments, demonstrates his fondness for traditional recipes from his native Normandy, to which he is increasingly adding his own distinctive culinary hallmark....
